# ExplainableEnergyAI

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
AI models for energy management that produce human-interpretable explanations for their predictions or control actions. Enables trust and debugging in adaptive TCC/iNEST systems where energy-aware routing or neuromorphic spiking decisions must be auditable.
